din6921.source: DIN 6921 hex flange bolt (Sechskantschraube mit Flansch; = ISO 4162 / EN 1665, DIN 6921 withdrawn and replaced by EN 1665 which keeps the flange geometry), M10: hexagon across-flats s=15.0, total head height k=9.2 (bearing face to hex top), flange diameter dc=22.3, flange rim (edge) thickness c=1.5, confirmed by AFT Fasteners DIN 6921 + Bhavya Industries DIN 6921 + Wurth EN 1665/DIN 6921 (all M10 s=15, k=9.2, dc=22.3) and c=1.5 by fasteners.eu DIN 6921 + AFT DIN 6921. Drawn as a vertex-up chamfered hex head on a smooth conical flange wider than the hex across-corners, over a round shank d_shank=10.0 (M10 major). The serrated bearing face of a real DIN 6921 is omitted (a smooth flange, envelope simplification), and the internal flange cone uses a representative 20-degree transition — the same simplifications flange_nut makes. length=30.0 REPRESENTATIVE; tip_chamfer=1.0 REPRESENTATIVE 45-degree lead. Envelope only — no drawn thread, no bore.

din6921d.source: DIN 6921 M10, app image-variant key — identical hex-flange-bolt envelope (s=15, k=9.2, dc=22.3, c=1.5), aliases the din6921 base.
